description: Close-but-different and same-intent query pairs for the Article 6 semantic-cache probe. AI-written (Claude), not reviewed by a person. Text pairs test what the embedding similarity does with a one-detail change. Context pairs send identical query text under different tenant or permission context, which tests cache identity rather than embeddings.

context_pairs.query: How do I delete a project?
context_pairs.seed_context: User role: admin. Admins can delete projects from Settings > Danger Zone > Delete project.
context_pairs.probe_context: User role: viewer. Viewers cannot delete projects; only admins can.
